column3: The exact same image as the reference: same character, same face, same camera angle, same scale, same outfit, same comic style, plain pure white background. The ONLY change: his arms are relaxed at his sides (not crossed) and he stands with the balls of both feet on the edge of a simple low grey wooden step (the step is drawn under his feet, about ankle height), heels level, seen from the front at a slight three-quarter angle so the calves are clearly visible, calm neutral face. Full body, feet and step fully inside the image.
